Sooraj is a common name in India, Nepal, and other countries with a significant Hindu population.

It represents divine energy, strength, and wisdom. People with the name Suraj are believed to have the qualities of the Sun God - radiance, courage, and intellect. The name is a reminder of the divine presence of the Sun in our lives and a reminder of the divine source of our energy and vitality.

historical_references.reference: Sooraj is the Sanskrit name for the Sun God. He is mentioned in the Rigveda, the oldest known Hindu scripture, which was composed between 1500-1200 BCE.

Another reference to Sooraj can be found in the Mahabharata, an epic Sanskrit poem that was likely composed between 400 BCE and 200 CE. Sooraj is described as the celestial king who rides his chariot across the sky each day.
